definitions.scope: ordinary campaigns (1,000+ contestants, plausible dates, finance_crypto and the crypto/ambiguous/purchase-opportunity segments removed)
definitions.gate: every group needs 30 campaigns and 5 organizers; a cut finer than an industry (prize category, action, campaign type, or the top-quartile split inside one industry) needs 30 campaigns and 10 organizers on both sides of the split it appears in
definitions.conversion_clean: contestants over impressions, clean campaigns only (no repeatable action, 14 days or less), so runs of different length and cadence are comparable
definitions.value_index: contestants divided by the median contestants of every valued ordinary campaign in the same stated-USD prize pool band, independent of industry
definitions.prize_category: analyze.classify_prize applied to the lowest-position prize, full coverage (not the earlier classification file)
definitions.campaign_type: title/incentive-name/description regex from campaign_types.py; a campaign can match more than one type
definitions.action_uptake: completions of that action over contestants, median among campaigns offering it; never divided by worth
definitions.top_quartile_vs_rest: within one industry's clean subset, campaigns ranked by conversion; the top quarter compared with the remaining three quarters of the SAME industry, never against another industry
definitions.repeat_organizer_share: share of the industry's organizers who ran two or more ordinary campaigns in that industry
definitions.nth_campaign: this campaign's position among every campaign the site has run in the dataset (all industries), median across the group

nth_campaign_overall.note: pooled across every qualifying industry's clean subset, top decile vs bottom decile by conversion, for a threshold check against the per-industry quartile ratio above

duration_days.note: pooled across every qualifying industry's clean subset, top decile vs bottom decile by conversion, for a threshold check against the per-industry quartile ratio above
